title: aparine tricornis
intro: Aparine tricornis, commonly known as sticklewort, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipruritic properties, which make it beneficial for treating various health conditions. The health benefits of Aparine tricornis include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and alleviating itching. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia and anti-edema effects.
